description: compute_rdf on an isolated A-B pair in a 20 A periodic box: the only non-empty bin must contain the pair distance, both for an in-box pair (2.0 A) and for a pair split across the periodic x face (0.5 and 19.5, i.e. 1.0 A by minimum image).
source: Analytic pair distances; bin width r_max/n_bins = 6.0/200 = 0.03 A, so a peak bin centre is within half a bin (0.015 A) of the true distance.
